page.notes: Running head and page number partly covered by an ink stamp; the bracketed parts are unreadable. Line-end breaks "pecu/lij" and "restin/gui" have no printed hyphen visible, so the words are written whole; "restingui" is uncertain. "fuam" in the scan is read as suam (long s), marked as doubtful in the text. The reading "retentionis" is a guess at a partly printed word, and "ijsdem" is read from a close-set line. The letters "y s" below the text are taken as the gathering signature. "repetitu-rum" is printed with a colon after it, and the printer's punctuation is kept as "repetiturum?" only where the scan shows a question mark; otherwise it is uncertain.
